reason: Fresh-main V21 Release Closure Lane C audit at main 9e510b66a8fa4e103ca6466bab081fb4a02e8f6c confirms Known Finding KF-P1-05 remains active. UPDATE_SELF_TYPING_STATE writes self-side conversationId/accountId/platform back into the shared top-level typingState.byContactId row aliases, while UPDATE_CONTACT_TYPING_STATE owns those aliases for contact-side conversation identity and selectConversationTypingState uses the top-level conversationId as its fail-closed identity. Existing WhatsApp human-typing tests prove service dispatch but do not cover this Store authority collision, creating a release-critical executed-coverage gap. This work package adds one mandatory WP0 causal contract and repairs the single Store command owner without changing TypingStateService, selectors, workflows, dependencies, persistence, adapter behavior, or release packaging.

requiredBehavior: Contact-side conversationId/accountId/platform remain the sole owners of the shared top-level typing row identity aliases.
UPDATE_SELF_TYPING_STATE may update only nested self identity/state and must not overwrite shared top-level contact identity aliases.
When no contact-side identity exists, a self-only update must not manufacture top-level conversation/account/platform identity.
UPDATE_CONTACT_TYPING_STATE continues to update the top-level compatibility aliases from the contact side and preserves nested self state.
selectConversationTypingState continues to fail closed against the contact-owned top-level conversation identity.
The new regression lives under tests/wp0 so tools/wp0/run-tests.js enumerates it into mandatory Stage PRODUCT_WP0 execution.

boundaries.reason: UPDATE_CONTACT_TYPING_STATE and UPDATE_SELF_TYPING_STATE compose the shared row and currently assign conflicting top-level identity ownership.
The service correctly sends self identity inside UPDATE_SELF_TYPING_STATE payloads; it need not own shared Store row alias semantics.
selectConversationTypingState correctly fails closed using the shared top-level conversation identity once that alias remains contact-owned.
Existing tests cover TypingStateService dispatch/lifecycle but do not execute the Store command composition that causes KF-P1-05.
New failure-first mandatory WP0 contract proves the identity collision and closes the executed-test coverage gap.
